ticket.title: Teach outfeed about the eleventh repository so gaugeblock-common and gaugeblock-contracts can be published first
ticket.description: Teach outfeed about the eleventh repository (common) so gaugeblock-contracts and gaugeblock-common can be published before any member that depends on them. Evidence (2026-10-28): SUITE_TOOLS still lists only the original ten tools, so outfeed plan/publish/release and suite.lock ignore common entirely - a dry run planned six repositories and never mentioned it. Three details make the publish awkward and are part of this ticket. (1) common sits at 0.1.0-beta.1 with NO git tags at all, while crates.io holds only the 0.1.0-alpha.1 placeholder, so outfeed has no tag baseline and would compute a bump past the intended first real version. (2) outfeed release has no --override-version flag (only plan and apply do), so there is no way to force the intended version from the release path; add it and thread it into the plan for the targeted repository. (3) Expect to run the publish twice when an explicit override is used: the first pass lands the manifest/commit and the second picks up the tag, so the command must be idempotent and treat an already-published version as a no-op skip rather than an error. Also required: place common first in SUITE_RELEASE_WAVES (ahead of miter), teach publish ordering about a library-only repository, and make the binary-install step skip an entry with no bin (SuiteTool currently assumes every tool has one). Acceptance: outfeed plan --all lists common; outfeed publish can publish gaugeblock-contracts then gaugeblock-common at 0.1.0-beta.1 before any member; a repeat run is a clean no-op; outfeed release --override-version works for a single repository.

verification_receipt.summary: Merged to outfeed main (0538157 + 68397d6): common is registered as the eleventh repository (SUITE_TOOLS leads with it, empty bin_name so install reports Skipped("library-only"), SUITE_RELEASE_WAVES gains a leading common wave), and outfeed release accepts --override-version with an idempotent no-op when that version is already tagged. Verified by two dry runs from the harness root: the suite plan now lists 11 repositories with common first, and 'release common --override-version 0.1.0-beta.1' proposes v0.1.0-beta.1 rather than the overshooting beta.2, with binary install skipped. Gates: clippy --workspace --all-targets -D warnings clean, nextest --workspace 69/69, docs 9/9.

completed_items: Registered the eleventh repository: SUITE_TOOLS now leads with common (bin_name empty because the repo is library-only), install_tool_with_progress returns Skipped("library-only") for an entry with no binary, SUITE_RELEASE_WAVES gained a leading common wave so the contracts crate releases before any member, and the install summary falls back to the repository name. Tests updated for eleven members and switched from SUITE_TOOLS[0] to a name lookup. Verified by a real dry run from the harness root: the plan now lists 11 repositories and common is first (v0.1.0-beta.1 -> proposed v0.1.0-beta.2, commits GB-141/143/144/145/149). outfeed@0538157, clippy clean, nextest --workspace 69/69.
remaining_items: Two pieces of GB-151 remain. (1) --override-version on outfeed release: the dry run shows why it is needed - common's manifest is already 0.1.0-beta.1 and unpublished, so the bump calculator proposes beta.2, but the intended first real publish is 0.1.0-beta.1 (the alpha.1 placeholder on crates.io is the reservation). ReleaseArgs has no override_version field today (only PlanArgs/ApplyArgs do), so add it and thread it into the plan for the targeted repository. (2) Prove the publish path for a library-only repository: outfeed publish on common must publish gaugeblock-contracts then gaugeblock-common at the override version, treat an already-published version as a skip rather than an error (idempotent second run), and must run before any member that depends on gaugeblock-contracts. Also confirm suite.lock generation includes common now that it is in SUITE_TOOLS.

task.title: Teach outfeed about the eleventh repository so gaugeblock-common and gaugeblock-contracts can be published first
task.description: GB-141 added common/ as an eleventh checkout with its own Cargo workspace (gaugeblock-common + gaugeblock-contracts), but SUITE_TOOLS still lists only the original ten tools, so outfeed release --all, plan, publish and suite.lock ignore it entirely (a dry run today planned six repositories and never mentioned common). That blocks the release ordering the GB-143 decision requires: six members now depend on gaugeblock-contracts = 0.1.0-beta.1, which exists on crates.io only as the 0.1.0-alpha.1 placeholder, so any member publish fails until contracts is published at beta.1 - and outfeed is the tool that would publish it. Fix: register common in SUITE_TOOLS (name common, rel_path common, bin_name none since it ships no binary - the SuiteTool shape may need an optional binary), place it first in SUITE_RELEASE_WAVES ahead of miter, ensure publish ordering handles a library-only repository, and make the binary-install step skip entries without a bin. Acceptance: outfeed plan --all lists common, and outfeed publish can publish gaugeblock-contracts before any member that depends on it.
